description:
Value a wallet in USD on Base, Ethereum or Solana: each holding (native coin, USDC/USDT and any tokens you list) priced from on-chain pools, the total, and warnings for thin pools or positions bigger than their pool.

$0.005 USDC per call over x402. Failed calls cost nothing. Call without `payment` to get a quote.

When to use: You need a wallet's value in USD: each holding priced and the total.
Use instead: wallet_balance when amounts are enough (cheaper).
Parameters: address is required. chain: base (default), ethereum or solana. tokens: up to 20 extra contracts or mints to include.
Returns: holdings[] with amount, USD price, USD value and pool used, the total in USD, and warnings for thin pools or positions bigger than their pool.

address.description: 0x address on Base/Ethereum, or base58 address on Solana.

payment.description: Base64 x402 payment payload. Omit it to receive a quote; sign that and call again.

tokens.description: Extra token contracts or SPL mints to include.

name: wallet_portfolio
title: Wallet portfolio value
